programmes.d: Talkers are forced to mine a hazardous waste landfill for the secret ingredient to biscuits.
Warren and George hack Altura's defenses and discover Estes' secret plan.
Estes imprisons the captive talkers and blends, while Warren and George plan their attack on Altura.
Warren works with humans, talkers and blends to help George defeat Estes and Pandora.
In Upstate New York, a zombie baby proves to be an obstacle for a diverse group of survivors.
The team struggles to gas up in a dangerous oil refinery packed with zombies.
The team comes to Addy's rescue after a "family" of cannibals kidnaps her.
Citizen Z directs the team to a rumored helicopter controlled by a mysterious general.
A tornado forces the team to Warren's hometown. There, she searches for her long-lost husband.
The team fights for survival against a zombie-worshipping cult.
At a Wild West-style bar, the team enters a zombie-shooting contest.
A suspicious cosmonaut crashes on Citizen Z's station, putting him on high alert.
Split off from the others, Mack and Addy find themselves trapped by a zombie they just can't kill.
The team desperately tries to stop a nuclear meltdown in a plant full of radiated zombies.
An all-female commune in Utah is where the two groups of survivors reunite.
Murphy learns more about his abilities when he is kidnapped by a group of outlaws; zombies attack.
A change in plans has the team re-routed to a Colorado viral lab located in a nuclear missile silo.
Picking up moments after the launch, the team is split up trying to outrun the impending blast.
Each member of the group goes through a near-death experience while being attacked.
After tracking down Murphy, the group comes across a caravan of survivors transporting victims.
The group makes its way to the greenhouse where Batch 47 is being grown by Odegard.
A pregnant Serena tracks down Murphy; the survivors stumble across a hidden Mennonite farm.
Murphy separates from the group out of fear that they may take the baby away - and kill her.
While crossing the Mississippi River, the group is involved in an accident and 10K is separated.
Murphy is captured by an unbalanced zombie fan, who is eager to add him to a zombie museum.
Near Roswell, New Mexico, the group encounters a community led by a woman called Bernadette.
The team splits up because of a massive zombie horde and encounters a Native American tribe.
The group becomes embroiled in corporate politics at a hotel overtaken by white-collar survivors.
